case_title: Pathan Hussain Basha v. State of A.P.
mitigating_circumstances: Age of accused, time served in jail
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment
high_court_outcome: Acquitted father-in-law, confirmed conviction of husband and mother-in-law
neutral_facts: The accused, a husband and his mother-in-law, were charged with the death of a married woman. The deceased was married to the accused husband and lived with him. The deceased's family had promised to pay a dowry of Rs. 25,000, but only Rs. 15,000 was paid. The accused husband and his mother-in-law demanded the remaining Rs. 10,000, which the deceased's family could not provide. The accused harassed and subjected the deceased to cruelty, including beating and verbal abuse, for non-payment of the dowry. The deceased was unable to bear the harassment and committed suicide by hanging herself in the accused's house. The prosecution presented evidence including witness statements, medical reports, and the seized saree used for hanging. The trial court convicted all three accused, but the High Court acquitted the father-in-law. The Supreme Court upheld the conviction of the husband and mother-in-law but reduced their sentence to ten years of rigorous imprisonment.
